integrity: Original theorem and algebraic/numerical reproducibility checks provided; no claim of independent validation or absolute historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Requires deterministic hierarchical two-species patch occupancy, constant inferior effective colonisation, positive continuous periodic superior colonisation, and strictly positive mean resident growth. No assertion for both seasonally varying rates, finite populations or stochastic spatial lattices.
title: Periodic habitat clustering strictly rescues a marginal coloniser in hierarchical metacommunities
